Mesha.text: Today brings a sense of introspection as you navigate the complexities of your daily routine. Kuja in the third house is blocked, so avoid impulsive communication or unnecessary debates with siblings. Shukra in the seventh house is adverse, suggesting that you should approach personal partnerships with extra patience and grace. Ketu in the fifth house adds a layer of detachment to your personal expressions. Rahu in the eleventh house is favourable, providing unexpected support from your social circles. As you are in the rising phase of Sade Sati, keep your expectations grounded and focus on steady progress. Trust that your quiet efforts will eventually bear fruit. Stay patient and kind to yourself throughout this process.
Mesha.advice: Focus on completing your pending tasks with patience rather than rushing for immediate results.
